title: Production checkout failures after payment gateway update
description: Multiple customers are reporting failed checkout attempts after the payment gateway update. Support has 18 tickets from the last two hours and revenue impact is likely.

title: Security review found exposed admin endpoint
description: The security team found an admin endpoint that is reachable without the expected network restriction. No exploit is confirmed, but the endpoint controls account-level settings.

title: Analytics vendor API delay blocks launch reporting
description: The analytics vendor has delayed delivery of the campaign attribution API. Launch reporting depends on this data and the marketing release is scheduled for Friday.

title: Requirement for enterprise SSO approval flow is unclear
description: The team does not know whether enterprise SSO requires admin approval, legal approval, or both. Engineering is estimating the work, but the acceptance criteria are incomplete.

title: Mobile sprint work blocked by design token mismatch
description: Mobile implementation is blocked because design tokens in Figma do not match the shared component library. Three stories are waiting on a decision from design systems.

title: Executive decision needed on regional rollout scope
description: The rollout plan needs a decision on whether Canada is included in the first release. Compliance, support staffing, and launch messaging all depend on the scope decision.

title: Add dark mode preference to account settings
description: A few users requested a dark mode preference in account settings. This is a nice-to-have enhancement and does not affect the current launch plan.

title: Update onboarding documentation screenshots
description: The onboarding guide still shows the old settings page. New screenshots should be added before the next customer enablement session.

title: Data retention policy missing for audit export
description: The audit export feature does not yet document how long exported records are retained. Legal review is pending and enterprise customers have asked for this policy.

title: Database migration may slow billing jobs
description: The planned database migration could increase billing job runtime during the monthly invoice cycle. The infrastructure team recommends a dry run before the next billing window.

title: Customer success needs release notes for new permissions model
description: Customer success cannot prepare training materials until release notes explain the new permissions model. The launch is next week and several enterprise admins need guidance.

title: Refactor settings page CSS
description: The settings page CSS has duplicated spacing rules. Refactoring would improve maintainability but does not block current roadmap work.
